contentPattern.structure: tab label + rich content panel (paragraphs, images, lists) per tab

suitableFor: adventure/product detail pages grouping long-form body content under labeled tabs (Overview, Itinerary, What to Bring)
any page where related content should be split into user-selectable sections
notSuitableFor: single continuous body of content (use default content)
expandable Q&A where multiple sections open at once (use accordion)

notes: Created to match the project's plain-named boilerplate convention (cards, columns, hero, carousel are all base-named). Vanilla Block Collection tabs copied verbatim; base '.tabs' classes retained since the block name is unchanged. This is the defining structural block of the adventure-detail template.
